VEML7700._notes: ALS sensor with range 0-120 klx. I2C address fixed at 0x10. Device ID register at 0x07. Returns 0x81c4 or 0x81d4 (0xc481/0xd481 as 16-bit LE). Config: gain x1, 100ms integration time, power on.

VEML6040._notes: RGBW ambient light sensor. I2C address fixed at 0x10. No dedicated device ID register, so detection relies on address and response behavior.

VL6180._notes:
Interleaved mode ALS & Range (0x2a3=>0x01)
Range settings defined in https://www.st.com/resource/en/application_note/an4545-vl6180x-basic-ranging-application-note-stmicroelectronics.pdf
ALS integration period 100ms (0x0040=>0x0063)
ALS gain 20 (0x003f=>0x40)

VL53L0X._notes: ToF distance sensor with range up to 2m. Initialization sequence adapted from the Pololu library.

VL53L1X._notes: ToF distance sensor with extended range up to 4m

MAX30101._notes: init: 0x0940 (reset), 0x00=r1 (clear INT), 0x0903 (SpO2mode Red+IR), 0x085f (4 sample avg, FIFO rollover, FIFO Int 17), 0x0A27 (100 samples/s, 18bit), 0x0c40&0x0d40 (LEDs 12.6mA), 0x1121 (Slot interleaved)

MXC400xXC._notes: x in part code sets i2c address LSB from 0x10-0x17

MMC5603._notes: MEMSIC MMC5603NJ 3-axis magnetometer. Product ID reg 0x39=0x10. Init: SW reset (CTRL1 0x1C=0x80, wait 20ms), SET/RESET pulses (CTRL0 0x1B=0x08 then 0x10) to null bridge offset, ODR reg 0x1A=0x64 (100Hz), continuous mode with auto set/reset (CTRL0 0x1B=0xA0 = cmm_freq_en|Auto_SR_en) and CTRL2 0x1D=0x10 (cmm_en). Poll reads 6 bytes 0x00-0x05 (top 16 bits of each 20-bit axis, big-endian). Zero-field null=32768, 0.1uT/LSB, range +/-30 Gauss (+/-3000uT).

LSM6DS._notes: FIFO-enabled 6-axis IMU. FIFO continuous mode at matched sensor ODR. FIFO depth is LIMITED to the watermark (FIFO_CTRL4.STOP_ON_FTH=1, FTH=1020 words via FIFO_CTRL1/2) so DIFF_FIFO can never wrap to 0: with an unlimited depth a host pause of >6.6 s (e.g. an RSAO test-mode or commissioning session) filled the 4096-word FIFO, the count read 0 and the {$0.w12} poll read nothing forever (devdocs/lsm6ds-fifo-full-deadlock.md, 2026-09-11). Two-phase I2C read: first reads FIFO_STATUS1-4 (word count), then reads only the required FIFO data bytes from 0x3E. FIFO_PATTERN (STATUS3/4) used to skip to next aligned group boundary before decoding. Each sample = 6 words (gx,gy,gz,ax,ay,az). Compatible with LSM6DS3, LSM6DS33, LSM6DSM. DSOX uses different FIFO architecture.

c.c: int W=((buf[1]&0x0F)<<8)|buf[0];int P=((buf[3]&0x03)<<8)|buf[2];int skip=(6-P%6)%6;int N=(W-skip)/6;int maxN=(240-skip*2)/12;if(N>maxN){N=maxN;}if(N<1){N=0;}int k=4+skip*2;int i=0;while(i<N){out.gx=(buf[k+1]<<8)|buf[k];out.gy=(buf[k+3]<<8)|buf[k+2];out.gz=(buf[k+5]<<8)|buf[k+4];out.ax=(buf[k+7]<<8)|buf[k+6];out.ay=(buf[k+9]<<8)|buf[k+8];out.az=(buf[k+11]<<8)|buf[k+10];k+=12;i++;next;}

TMP117._notes: High-Accuracy Temperature Sensor. Detection: 0x0F (DevID) = 0x0117. Init: 0x01 (Config) = 0x0220 (1s continuous mode, 8 avg). Poll: 0x00 (Temp) = 2 bytes.

AHT20._notes: Temperature and humidity sensor. Data format: Status(8bit) + Humidity(20bit) + Temperature(20bit). Conversion: humidity(%) = (H[19:0]/2^20)*100, temp(°C) = (T[19:0]/2^20)*200-50

SHT40._notes: Sensirion SHT4x (SHT40) at 0x44. Uses high-precision single-shot command 0xFD. Response is 6 bytes: T_MSB,T_LSB,T_CRC,RH_MSB,RH_LSB,RH_CRC.

SGP30._notes: Gas sensor for IAQ. Detection: 0x0000 = 0x58, 0x00 = config. Init: Send IAQ_INIT and wait 100ms, then poll. Poll: Send MEASURE_IAQ and read 6 bytes (CO2 & TVOC).

SGP40._notes: Gas sensor for VOC measurements (0-500). Hotplate temp controlled by command 0x59. Init: None needed. Poll: Send 0x2600 + humidity/temp compensation (default to 50%RH=0x8000, 25°C=0x6666), read raw signal (VOC ticks).

MPRLS._notes: Honeywell MPRLS pressure sensor. No detection values, so the record claims any device at 0x18 - it must stay AFTER the MCP9808 and Robotical servo/pump records, which share the address and have detection values.

CAP1188._notes: Microchip CAP1188 8-channel capacitive touch sensor with 8 LED drivers. Product ID 0x50, Manufacturer ID 0x5D. ADDR_COMM strap selects address in range 0x28-0x2D.

AdafruitSoilSensor._notes: sensor must be wrapped in heatshrink to produce sensible values. very sensitive to human proximity

SCD30._notes: Sensirion SCD30 CO2/temperature/humidity. No detection values (unique address 0x61).

SCD40._notes: Sensirion SCD40 CO2/temperature/humidity. No detection values (unique address 0x62).

c.c: out.CO2 = buf[0]; out.temperature = -45.0 + (175.0 * buf[1] / 65535.0); out.humidity = (100.0 * buf[2] / 65535.0);

STCC4._notes: Sensirion STCC4 miniature CO2 sensor (paired with SHT41 for RH/T compensation), fixed address 0x64. Detection is empty (unique address) - the product-ID command cannot be used because the detection path issues a single write+read with no inter-command delay and the STCC4 NACKs that read - so the record claims any device at 0x64. Init: start_continuous_measurement (0x218B). Poll: read_measurement (0xEC05), 1 ms pause, read 12 bytes = CO2/temp/humidity/status words each followed by a CRC byte (skipped via 'at'). CO2 raw = ppm; temperature = -45 + 175*s/65535; humidity = -6 + 125*s/65535. Must never be probed by the RSAO delegated-identification hook (its framed 0x99 command stops the sensor measuring); RaftI2C DeviceIdentMgr only runs that hook for addresses with no standard device-type record. See devdocs/stcc4-identification-notes.md

GravityO2._notes: DFRobot Gravity O2 sensor. No detection values; addresses 0x70-0x73 overlap the usual I2C mux range, so a board with a mux at those addresses must exclude them.

c.c: float key = 20.9/120.0; float val = key * (buf[0] + (buf[1]/10.0) + (buf[2]/100.0)); out.oxygen = val;

AMG8833._notes: default settings on power on: normal (not sleep) mode, 10 frames per second, no interrupt, moving average off

TrillBar._notes: Bela Trill Bar - 1D capacitive touch, 26 channels, up to 5 simultaneous touches. CENTROID mode. Identify cmd returns device_type=1 in byte 1 of 3-byte response. Address jumper-configurable 0x20-0x27.

TrillSquare._notes: Bela Trill Square - 2D capacitive touch, 30 channels, up to 4 simultaneous touches. CENTROID mode returns 4 vertical loc+size pairs followed by 4 horizontal loc+size pairs. Address jumper-configurable 0x28-0x2F.

TrillCraft._notes: Bela Trill Craft - 1D capacitive sensor strip, 30 channels, up to 5 simultaneous touches in CENTROID mode (default DIFF). Address jumper-configurable 0x30-0x37.

TrillRing._notes: Bela Trill Ring - 1D circular capacitive touch, 28 ring channels + 2 button channels, up to 5 touches. CENTROID response: 5 loc + 5 size + 2 button values (uint16 BE). Address jumper-configurable 0x38-0x3F.

TrillHex._notes: Bela Trill Hex - 2D hexagonal capacitive touch pad, 30 channels, up to 4 simultaneous touches. CENTROID response: 4 vertical loc + 4 vertical size + 4 horizontal loc + 4 horizontal size (uint16 BE). Address jumper-configurable 0x40-0x47.

TrillFlex._notes: Bela Trill Flex - flexible 1D capacitive touch with custom electrode connection, 30 channels, up to 5 touches in CENTROID mode (default DIFF). Address jumper-configurable 0x48-0x4F.

LTR-329._notes: Detection effectively matches any device at 0x29 - this record must stay AFTER every other 0x29 record (VL6180, VL53L0X, VL53L1X, VL53L4CD, CAP1188, TrillSquare).

c.c: int combined = buf[2] + (((uint16_t)buf[3])<<8); out.ir = buf[0] + (((uint16_t)buf[1])<<8); out.visible = combined - out.ir;
c.j: let combined = buf[2] + (buf[3]<<8); let ir = buf[0] + (buf[1]<<8); attrValues['ir'].push(ir); attrValues['visible'].push(combined-ir);
